messages:
Nina: Quick run through of the latest chart card. Two things popped out: scientific notation at ~1200 (1.2e+03) and a smoothing option that hides a tiny but important spike in infra metrics. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/metrics_v3.png
Omar: We should never show e-notation in the UI by default. Rule: use plain integers up to 999,999, then use SI suffixes (k, M) with 2 sig figs. Keep exports able to toggle scientific.
Ben: Smoothing: current cubic spline looks nice but obliterates brief alerts. Add "preserve spikes" mode that overlays sentinel markers for points > 3 std dev and keeps raw dots for those points. Smoothing remains visual-only.
Lina: Legend behavior is inconsistent: hover dims others, click toggles. Propose: hover only highlights (no DOM change), click pins the series (aria-pressed="true"), second click unpins. Keyboard: Enter toggles pin. Also truncate long names with ellipsis; full name on hover and accessible name for SR.
Nina: Axis ticks: for ranges <1 use 2 decimal places, for ranges 1-1000 use integer ticks, >1000 use SI formatting. Avoid showing weird values like 0.00037. Always show zero if it falls in range.
Omar: Also add a tiny helper for log scale charts: small badge "log" that indicates compression; tooltip explains unsuitability for negatives. Switching scale should announce via aria-live.
Ben: Copy nit: change "smoothing" toggle label to "Line smoothing (preserve spikes)" and add an info icon that opens a tiny modal describing visual-only semantics.
Lina: Accessibility: screen reader should read units as words ("one point two thousand") and legend pin state. Use aria-labels like "Series A, pinned, 3 series total". Also ensure sentinel markers have accessible name "Outlier: value at time" in the DOM.
Nina: Action items: Omar -> number formatting token + example table; Ben -> sentinel visuals + tests; Lina -> aria labels and keyboard interactions; I'll update copy in strings.yml.
designbot: Task created: https://design.redwood/tasks/CHART-2301  assignees: Omar, Ben, Lina  due: 4 days :memo:
Omar: I'll include a before/after screenshot for 999 vs 1k edge-case.
Ben: I'll add visual regression fixtures for smoothing modes and sentinel overlays.
Lina: Will draft SR narration transcript for the PR.
Nina: Thanks team, small follow-up: can someone run colorblind palette v3 against these markers? want to confirm contrast at small sizes.
Omar: will run quick contrast checks and post results here.
Nina: Great, thanks :thumbsup:
__notes: Slack thread export: concise messages, chronological, agents.md schema compliant
